say:4:1060602003:1.text: I'm Philip, a traveling merchant. I'm here to join the Mithril Consortium in Holistone!
say:4:1060602003:1.source_cn: 我叫菲勒，是一个流浪商人。我这次来圣石镇不是为了做生意...

say:5:1060602004:1.text: However, the Mithril Consortium just turned me down.
say:5:1060602004:1.source_cn: 不过……就在刚才，我被秘银商会拒绝了。

say:6:1060602005:1.text: They said my business acumen did not meet their standards and that my wares were of average workmanship. But these are all the treasures I've collected through the years...
say:6:1060602005:1.source_cn: 他们说我的商业成绩不符合入会标准，货物做工一般，品相也...

say:7:1060602006:1.text: I was hoping you could examine my goods and offer some advice on what I should stock. Of course, you will be compensated.
